correctness.rationale: Weighted prescribed-arrow contraction counts cycles already closed and contracts the other directed paths; for two adjacent source arrows, the aligned image creates exactly two loops and each other image choice creates no forced cycle. This gives E L=(n−1)(theta²+n−2)/D and E R=n(theta²+n−1)/D. The exponential-family score identity Cov(K,X)=theta d/dtheta E X yields both exact quadratic covariance numerators. Their negative constants and positive leading coefficients give unique positive roots straddling theta=1, with exact 1/n² and −1/(n−1)² values. Independently enumerated all permutations n=3..6 for theta 1/2,1,2 with rational weights; symbolic expansion checks both root limits. All-n results follow from contraction and sign algebra.
residual_risks: No formal theorem prover certification; bounded finite checks not all-size proofs.
